title: Replace an Owner-Builder Permit
summary: This page explains how to apply for a replacement Owner-Builder Permit if your original permit has been lost, stolen, or damaged.
intro: If you've been granted an Owner-Builder Permit to supervise building work on your own private residential premises, and your permit has been damaged, lost or stolen, you can apply for a replacement at a service centre.
who_can_apply: You must have been granted an Owner-Builder Permit to supervise building work on your own private residential premises.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for duplicate licence, certificate or permit'
Your personal details and permit number

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete an Application for duplicate licence, certificate or permit – PDF.
Take your application and payment to a service centre.

external_links.text: Application for duplicate licence, certificate or permit – PDF

internal_links.text: Change the details on an Owner-Builder Permit

faqs.q: What do I need to do if my Owner-Builder Permit is lost or damaged?
faqs.a: You can apply for a replacement permit at a service centre.

faqs.q: How can I check my permit number and details?
faqs.a: You can visit Verify NSW to check your permit number and details.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my application for a replacement permit?
faqs.a: You must take your application and payment to a service centre.
